item.isekai_mahou.reishi_restoration.des: Drink: removes ALL Aging at once (milk does not cure it) and heals a little.
item.isekai_mahou.murcielago_wing.desc: Use: Sonído — vanish and reappear up to 9 blocks ahead.
item.isekai_mahou.arrogante_shard.desc: Use: a breath of Respira — ages creatures ahead and turns projectiles to dust.
item.isekai_mahou.pantera_claw.desc: Use: Desgarrón — five blue claws tear through everything ahead.
effect.isekai_mahou.aged.description: Barragan's Respira aged your body: slower, weaker, less health, hunger and rotting armor. Milk does not cure it.
message.isekai_mahou.espada.restored: Your body mends itself: the Aging is gone.
message.isekai_mahou.espada.restored_non: The spirit particles restore your strength.
command.isekai_mahou.espada.spawn_fail: Could not summon the Espada here.
boss.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.subtitle: Cuarta Espada — the aspect of Despair
announce.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.intro: Ulquiorra Cifer, the Cuarta Espada, opens his cold green eyes.
announce.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.death: Ulquiorra crumbles into ash, carried off by the wind of Hueco Mundo.
announce.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.hierro_b: Ulquiorra's Hierro cracked! Now he feels your blows!
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.intro: Trash. You came all this way only to measure the distance between us.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q1: Is that all? Not even worth taking my hands out of my pockets.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q2: I see nothing in your eyes that I need to fear.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q3: Heart... you keep saying that word as if it changed anything.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q_mur2: No other Espada has seen this form.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q_seg1: Look closely. This is true despair.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q_seg2: There is nothing left in you to break.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.q_seg3: Why do you still stand up?
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.death: So... this is what you kept inside your chest.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.death2: I would have liked... to understand a little more.
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.hierro: Hierro: weak hits barely get through. Use STRONG hits to crack his skin!
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.murcielag: Murciélago: he flies and regenerates. Beware of Cero Oscuras!
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.oscuras: Cero Oscuras: the black orb in his hand is the warning — leave the dark lane marked on the ground!
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.segunda: Segunda Etapa: watch the tail and the Lanza del Relámpago!
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.lanza: Lanza del Relámpago: the mark follows you, then locks — the spear makes a GIANT explosion where it lands and a green shockwave follows. Run FAR from the red circle!
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.dome: Ulquiorra looks up... the Segunda Etapa only awakens atop the dome.
boss.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.release1.sub: Enclávate, Murciélago — black reiatsu rains down
title.isekai_mahou.espada.ulquiorra: The One Who Touched the Heart
boss.isekai_mahou.barragan.subtitle: Segunda Espada — the aspect of Old Age, King of Hueco Mundo
announce.isekai_mahou.barragan.intro: Barragan Louisenbairn, the Segunda Espada, rises from his throne.
announce.isekai_mahou.barragan.death: The God-King turns to dust — the same dust he spread.
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.intro: Kneel. You stand before the God-King of Hueco Mundo.
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.q1: Everything ages. Everything rots. Even you.
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.q3: Such insolence, facing a king standing up!
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.fraccion: Fracción! Rid me of these worms!
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.q_rel1: Nothing that touches me survives time!
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.q_rel2: Your weapons? Dust. Your flesh? Dust.
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.q_rel3: I am the death that comes for all!
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.aged: Look at you... already bent with age.
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.respira: Respira: the miasma bursts out in EVERY direction and AGES you! Get far away from Barragan before the purple cloud reaches you.
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.projectile: Projectiles rot near Barragan — only half the damage gets through.
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.arrogante: Arrogante: Barragan became the bone King! Standing next to him ages you. Milk won't cure it — use Reishi Restoration.
boss.isekai_mahou.barragan.release.sub: Flesh turns to dust; the bone King of Hueco Mundo remains
boss.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.subtitle: Sexta Espada — the aspect of Destruction
announce.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.intro: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez, the Sexta Espada, grins at the fight.
announce.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.death: Grimmjow falls, grinding his teeth to the very end.
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.intro: Finally someone worth it! Come on, show me what you've got!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.q1: That's it? I haven't even broken a sweat!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.q2: I'm the king! Nobody stands in front of me!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.q4: I like that look. I'm gonna tear it off your face!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.q_rel1: Now we're talking! This is a real fight!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.q_rel2: I'll shred you with these claws!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.q_rel3: I'll be the king! Out of my way!
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.death: Damn it... I'm not... done yet...
message.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.pantera: Pantera: much faster! His roar blasts everyone away.
message.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.gran_rey: Gran Rey Cero: get out of the blue marked lane!
message.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.desgarron: Desgarrón: five giant claws fly down the blue lanes — slip BETWEEN them or step aside!
boss.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.release.sub: Kishire, Pantera — the panther king awakens
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.outside: In here, a Cero Oscuras would bring Las Noches down. We take this outside.
quote.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.dome: Up here there is nothing left to protect. Now you will see true despair.
boss.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.outside.sub: Ulquiorra takes the fight to the top of the dome
boss.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.dome: Top of the Las Noches Dome
boss.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.dome.sub: Under the moon of Hueco Mundo — nothing holds his power back
message.isekai_mahou.ulquiorra.outside: Ulquiorra rises: the fight moves to the TOP of the Las Noches dome!
boss.isekai_mahou.barragan.phase3.sub: Decay covers the arena — run to the green zones
announce.isekai_mahou.barragan.phase3: The King of Hueco Mundo reaches out: everything will age!
announce.isekai_mahou.barragan.ruin: Bow before the RUIN OF THE THRONE!
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.domain: I am the King of Hueco Mundo. Your time is over.
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.ruin: Ruin of the Throne: the waves come from the axe — step where a wave ALREADY passed!
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.pools: Pools of Decay follow you — keep moving!
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.domain: Respira: Senescence! Run to the green zones before the decay covers everything!
message.isekai_mahou.barragan.exhausted: The King is exhausted: strike now!
quote.isekai_mahou.barragan.taunt: Dust. Like everything before the king.
quote.isekai_mahou.grimmjow.taunt: Done already? Get up, I'm not finished!
glyph.isekai_mahou.espada_tech_desgarron: Grimmjow's technique (legendary form, Wind, C6). Five GIANT blue-white claw marks are LAUNCHED side by side and fly 30 blocks (Expand +4), cutting everything in their path (each claw cuts each target once) and causing bleeding. Split: +1 claw. Learned by defeating Grimmjow.
glyph.isekai_mahou.espada_tech_respira.d: Barragan's technique (legendary form, Shadow, C7). The miasma bursts out 360° around you: a purple-black dome that spreads 10 blocks (Expand +2) and lingers 3 s (Extend +1 s). Whoever breathes it AGES, withers (Wither) and slows down. Learned by defeating Barragan.
glyph.isekai_mahou.espada_tech_lanza.des: Ulquiorra's technique (legendary form, Shadow, C8). Forms the green spear and THROWS it (48 blocks): on impact, a GIANT explosion (green dome and pillar of light, radius 10) and a shockwave out to 18 blocks (Expand increases both). Does not break blocks. Learned by defeating Ulquiorra.
message.isekai_mahou.espada.technique_le: ✦ You learned the Espada's technique: %s (see Legends in the Grimoire)
